# Audionic

> > Pakistan's leading audio lifestyle brand offering premium wireless earbuds, speakers, and audio accessories with advanced features like ANC, gaming optimization, and app-based connectivity.

Audionic is a comprehensive e-commerce platform specializing in wireless audio products for the Pakistani market. The site features an extensive catalog of earbuds (including ANC, gaming, and ENC variants), speakers (portable, Bluetooth, soundbars, and trolley models), with detailed product specifications, competitive pricing, and promotional sales.

## Key Topics

- Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)
- Wireless Earbuds
- Bluetooth 5.4
- Gaming Earbuds
- Battlebuds Series
- Trance Airbud Series
- Audionic Suite App
- ENC (Environmental Noise Cancellation)
- Low-Latency Gaming
- Portable Speakers
- Soundbars & Home Theater
- USB-C Charging
- Pakistan E-commerce
- Warranty & Free Shipping
- Discount Sales

## Featured Products

- [Airbud 735 Ion with ANC](https://audionic.co/products/airbud-735-ion-with-anc): Premium wireless earbuds with Bluetooth 5.4 and active noise cancellation
- [Battlebuds NEO ANC Gaming Buds](https://audionic.co/products/battlebuds-neo-anc-gaming-buds): Gaming-optimized earbuds with ANC and low-latency performance
- [Trance Airbud 815 with ANC](https://audionic.co/products/trance-airbud-815-with-anc): Ultra-long battery life wireless earbuds with 120 hours of playtime and ANC
- [Trance Airbud 850 Hexa Mic with ANC](https://audionic.co/products/trance-airbud-850-hexa-mic-with-anc): Advanced earbuds with six-mic ANC system and 3D immersive sound
- [Trance Airbud 810 with Display and Quad Mic ANC](https://audionic.co/products/trance-airbud-810-with-display-and-anc): Feature-rich earbuds with LED display screen and quad-mic noise cancellation
